events.name: New York Islanders at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat broke a tie late in the third period and the New York Islanders went into the Olympic break with a 3-1 win over the New Jersey Devils on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Horvat's late goal lifts Islanders to 3-1 win over Devils

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Rookie Brandon Bussi made 16 saves for his second shutout, Andrei Svechnikov gave Carolina an early lead in the first period and the Hurricanes topped the New York Rangers 2-0 on Thursday night to extend their points streak to 10 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bussi makes 16 saves and Svechnikov scores early goal to lift Hurricanes over Rangers 2-0

headlines.description: — Tim Stutzle charged past Philadelphia defenseman Travis Sanheim and scored on a back-hand shot 47 seconds into overtime Thursday night, helping the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 victory over the struggling Flyers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tim Stutzle's goal 47 seconds into OT helps Senators beat Flyers 2-1

headlines.description: — Pierre-Luc Dubois scored in his first game since Halloween, Jakob Chychrun added a pair of goals and the Washington Capitals beat the Nashville Predators 4-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dubois scores in his return for Washington, and the Capitals beat the Predators 4-2

events.name: Florida Panthers at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 33 shots to improve to 16-0-1 in his past 17 games, helping the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Florida Panthers 6-1 on Thursday night in the final game for both teams before the Olympic break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vasilevskiy stops 33 shots, Lightning beat Panthers 6-1 in final game before break

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Mark Stone had a goal and two assists and the Vegas Golden Knights took control early Thursday night by scoring four times on their first six shots for a 4-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Golden Knights dominate Kings 4-1 with early scoring blitz
